schema.app_name: Online Alarm Clock - Tap to Tool
schema.app_description: Configure multiple online alarms. Customize with your own sounds, drag to organize and manage your alerts with precision.
schema.howto_name: How to Use the Online Alarm Clock
schema.howto_description: The online alarm clock is a powerful tool for setting and managing several simultaneous alarms.
schema.step1_text: Click the '+ New Alarm' button to generate a new configuration card.
schema.step2_text: Select the desired hours and minutes using the digital selectors on each card.
schema.step3_text: Name your alarm by clicking the title and upload a custom audio file by clicking the audio selection button.
schema.step4_text: Drag the cards to set visual priority. The alarm will go off automatically when the countdown reaches zero.

ui.intro_text: Streamline your routine with our intuitive online alarm clock. Set reminders, wake up to your favorite tracks, and stay organized.

content.feature_audio: Audio Customization: Use default sounds or upload your own audio files.
content.feature_org: Smart Organization: Click and hold to reorder alarms based on your priority.
content.feature_multiple: Multiple Alarms: Create as many alarms as you need for your daily tasks.
content.feature_save: Auto-Save: Your alarms are saved in the browser, ready for your next session.
content.usage_step1: Click '+ New Alarm' to add a new card.
content.usage_step2: Adjust the hour and minute toggles.
content.usage_step3: Click the name to rename your alarm.
content.usage_step4: Click the audio button to pick a sound from your computer.
content.tip_drag: Click and drag any card to reorder your list.
content.tip_rename: Label your alarms (e.g., 'Medicine', 'Meeting') for better tracking.
content.tip_test: Use the play icon to preview your sound before setting it.
content.footer_text: Manage your day instantly with the Tap to Tool Online Alarm Clock!
